prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original finished fantasy RPG character portrait for OpenGold. Target 1024x1024 square or larger native square. One complete unified chest-up portrait, never separate head/body parts. Traditional hand-painted fantasy CRPG portrait aesthetic, realistic textured brushwork, rich restrained palette, soft warm key light and muted dark charcoal atmospheric background. Face large and readable as a small party icon, full top of head including horns within frame, shoulders visible, breathing room above head. All characters adults with individual faces and varied adult ages; fantasy anatomy must clearly communicate the species. Practical class clothing, no sexualized poses. Single individual only; no collage, panels, borders, text, watermark, logos or existing copyrighted characters. Original independently designed artwork, not derived from the screenshot or original game assets.
Subject: Dragonborn, a fully draconic humanoid with a scaled dragon face, pronounced reptilian muzzle, horns and no human hair; clearly not a human wearing a mask; non-binary adult (gender is catalog metadata, not an anatomical stereotype), individual gender expression and natural presentation. Appearance: Distinctive natural variation appropriate to this fantasy species. Class: cleric; chainmail and a modest ivory tabard, a small original abstract holy emblem, compassionate resolve. Distinct individual variation seed: 600; use this only to vary age, hairstyle, face, pose and costume detail, never render numbers.
Individual art direction: older adult, about 65 with visible natural age lines; three-quarter view facing slightly right, resolute expression. Scales in charcoal black, a distinctive draconic muzzle and horn silhouette.Keep the established painted finish and large readable face.
